CREATE TRIGGER `orders_negotiationrevision_insert_guard` BEFORE INSERT ON `orders_negotiationrevision` FOR EACH ROW BEGIN DECLARE request_id CHAR(32); DECLARE buyer_id CHAR(32); DECLARE seller_id CHAR(32); DECLARE currency_code VARCHAR(3);

CREATE TRIGGER `orders_negotiationoutcome_update_guard` BEFORE UPDATE ON `orders_negotiationoutcome` FOR EACH ROW BEGIN IF COALESCE((OLD.state<>'pending' OR NOT ((OLD.`id` <=> NEW.`id`) AND (OLD.`submission_id` <=> NEW.`submission_id`) AND (OLD.`seller_id` <=> NEW.`seller_id`)) OR NEW.version<>OLD.version+1), TRUE) THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='Retained history or invalid transition'; END IF;IF COALESCE((NEW.state='submitted' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM orders_negotiation r
        JOIN orders_negotiationrevision v ON v.request_id=r.id AND v.number=r.revision
        JOIN orders_negotiationevent e ON e.request_id=r.id AND e.version=r.version AND e.revision=r.revision AND e.action='submitted'
        WHERE r.outcome_id=NEW.id)), TRUE) THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='Incomplete initial request publication'; END IF; END

CREATE TRIGGER `orders_negotiationevent_insert_guard` BEFORE INSERT ON `orders_negotiationevent` FOR EACH ROW BEGIN DECLARE request_id CHAR(32); DECLARE current_state VARCHAR(20); DECLARE current_version BIGINT;
        DECLARE current_revision BIGINT; DECLARE buyer_id CHAR(32); DECLARE seller_id CHAR(32);
        SELECT r.id,r.state,r.version,r.revision,r.buyer_id,r.seller_id INTO request_id,current_state,current_version,current_revision,buyer_id,seller_id
        FROM orders_negotiation r WHERE r.id=NEW.request_id FOR UPDATE;IF COALESCE((NOT ((NEW.version=1 AND current_version=1 AND NEW.revision=1 AND current_revision=1 AND NEW.action='submitted'
            AND current_state='submitted' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM orders_negotiationevent existing_event WHERE existing_event.request_id=NEW.request_id))
        OR (NEW.version=current_version+1 AND (
            (current_state IN ('submitted','correction_requested') AND NEW.action IN ('withdrawn','rejected') AND NEW.revision=current_revision)
            OR (current_state='submitted' AND NEW.action IN ('accepted','correction_requested') AND NEW.revision=current_revision)
            OR (current_state='correction_requested' AND NEW.action='resubmitted' AND NEW.revision=current_revision+1)))) OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM orders_negotiationrevision proposed_revision WHERE proposed_revision.request_id=NEW.request_id AND proposed_revision.number=NEW.revision)), TRUE) THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='Invalid or incomplete request event'; END IF;IF COALESCE(((NEW.action IN ('submitted','resubmitted','withdrawn') AND NEW.actor_id<>buyer_id)
        OR (NEW.action IN ('accepted','rejected','correction_requested') AND NOT EXISTS(
            SELECT 1 FROM accounts_account a WHERE a.id=NEW.actor_id AND a.context='seller'
            AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM organizations_businessprofile p WHERE p.id=seller_id AND p.kind='individual' AND p.account_id=a.id)
                OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM organizations_membership m WHERE m.company_id=seller_id AND m.account_id=a.id
                    AND m.active AND (m.is_owner OR JSON_CONTAINS(m.bundles,'"orders_negotiation"'))))))), TRUE) THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='Wrong request event authority'; END IF;IF COALESCE((NEW.action='accepted' AND NOT (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM orders_sellerorder o
        JOIN orders_negotiationrevision rev ON rev.request_id=NEW.request_id AND rev.number=NEW.revision
        WHERE o.negotiation_id=NEW.request_id AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM orders_orderline WHERE order_id=o.id)
        AND o.goods_total=(SELECT SUM(goods_amount) FROM orders_orderline WHERE order_id=o.id)
        AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM orders_invoice WHERE order_id=o.id)
        AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM orders_orderevent WHERE order_id=o.id
            AND action=CASE WHEN o.negotiation_id IS NULL THEN 'fixed_order_accepted' ELSE 'negotiated_order_accepted' END))
        AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders_orderline WHERE order_id=o.id)=JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(rev.body,'$.lines'))
        AND JSON_EQUALS(JSON_EXTRACT(o.snapshot,'$.proposal'),rev.body)
        AND (JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.snapshot,'$.finalizer.account')) <=> CONCAT(SUBSTRING(NEW.actor_id,1,8),'-',SUBSTRING(NEW.actor_id,9,4),'-',SUBSTRING(NEW.actor_id,13,4),'-',SUBSTRING(NEW.actor_id,17,4),'-',SUBSTRING(NEW.actor_id,21,12)))))), TRUE) THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='Incomplete negotiated agreement'; END IF; END

CREATE TRIGGER `orders_negotiationevent_insert_advance` AFTER INSERT ON `orders_negotiationevent` FOR EACH ROW BEGIN IF NEW.version>1 THEN UPDATE orders_negotiation
        SET state=CASE WHEN NEW.action='resubmitted' THEN 'submitted' ELSE NEW.action END,
            version=NEW.version,revision=NEW.revision WHERE id=NEW.request_id; END IF; END
